data.label: Karyawan
data.description: Daftar karyawan, undangan, penonaktifan, tarif upah, dan batas jam kerja.
data.descriptionEn: Employee list, invitations, deactivation, pay rates, and work-hour limits.

data.label: Proyek
data.description: Proyek, tipe proyek, tugas di dalamnya, budget, dan laporan pemakaian budget.
data.descriptionEn: Projects, project types, their tasks, budgets, and budget usage reports.

data.label: Peran & Hak Akses
data.description: Membuat dan mengubah role custom beserta menu yang boleh dibukanya.
data.descriptionEn: Create and edit custom roles and which menus they can open.

data.label: Absensi
data.description: Clock in/out, istirahat, selfie absensi, dan rekap kehadiran perusahaan.
data.descriptionEn: Clock in/out, breaks, attendance selfies, and the company attendance summary.

data.label: Area Absensi
data.description: Titik dan radius lokasi yang sah untuk absensi, beserta jadwalnya.
data.descriptionEn: Valid attendance locations and their radius, along with their schedule.

data.label: Zona Terlarang
data.description: Area yang justru tidak boleh dipakai absensi.
data.descriptionEn: Areas where attendance is not allowed.

data.label: Verifikasi Wajah
data.description: Pendaftaran dan pemeriksaan wajah untuk absensi selfie.
data.descriptionEn: Face enrollment and verification for selfie attendance.

data.label: Cuti
data.description: Pengajuan cuti, persetujuan, kalender cuti, dan laporan pemakaiannya.
data.descriptionEn: Leave requests, approvals, the leave calendar, and usage reports.

data.label: Pengaturan Cuti
data.description: Jenis cuti, kebijakan dan tier, saldo karyawan, serta hari libur perusahaan.
data.descriptionEn: Leave types, policies and tiers, employee balances, and company holidays.

data.label: Timesheet
data.description: Pengiriman timesheet mingguan, persetujuan, revisi, dan ekspornya.
data.descriptionEn: Weekly timesheet submission, approval, revisions, and exports.

data.label: Screenshot
data.description: Tangkapan layar yang direkam aplikasi desktop saat tracking.
data.descriptionEn: Screenshots captured by the desktop app while tracking.

data.label: Log Aktivitas
data.description: Rekaman aktivitas aplikasi dan situs yang dipakai selama tracking.
data.descriptionEn: Records of apps and sites used during tracking.

data.label: Persetujuan Waktu Manual
data.description: Permintaan penambahan waktu manual yang menunggu persetujuan approver.
data.descriptionEn: Manual time-addition requests awaiting approver sign-off.

data.label: Pengaturan Waktu Manual
data.description: Aturan persetujuan waktu manual untuk seluruh company.
data.descriptionEn: Company-wide approval rules for manual time.

data.label: Divisi
data.description: Kelompok karyawan dengan satu atau lebih leader yang bisa melihat data anggotanya.
data.descriptionEn: Employee groups with one or more leaders who can view their members' data.

data.label: Lembur
data.description: Pengajuan lembur, perintah lembur, persetujuan, dan status lembur karyawan.
data.descriptionEn: Overtime requests, overtime orders, approvals, and employee overtime status.

data.label: Laporan Lembur
data.description: Laporan lembur karyawan per periode beserta ekspornya.
data.descriptionEn: Employee overtime reports per period and their exports.

data.label: Pengaturan Lembur
data.description: Mengaktifkan lembur, batas pengajuan mundur, dan daftar approver lembur.
data.descriptionEn: Turn overtime on or off, the back-dating window, and the overtime approver list.

data.label: Toko
data.description: Data toko, lokasinya, QR code, dan sales yang berhak.
data.descriptionEn: Store data, locations, QR codes, and the sales reps assigned to them.

data.label: Wilayah Toko
data.description: Pengelompokan toko per wilayah dan penugasan sales ke wilayah itu.
data.descriptionEn: Grouping stores into regions and assigning sales reps to those regions.

data.label: Kunjungan Toko
data.description: Check-in/check-out kunjungan sales, foto bukti, dan ekspor riwayatnya.
data.descriptionEn: Sales rep visit check-in/check-out, proof photos, and history exports.

data.label: Jadwal Kunjungan
data.description: Rencana kunjungan per sales per hari, kalendernya, dan kepatuhannya.
data.descriptionEn: Per-rep daily visit plans, their calendar, and compliance.

data.label: Master Kunjungan
data.description: Tipe kunjungan dan frekuensi kunjungan.
data.descriptionEn: Visit types and visit frequencies.

data.label: Form Kunjungan
data.description: Template form yang diisi sales saat kunjungan, versinya, dan hasil isiannya.
data.descriptionEn: Form templates sales reps fill in during visits, their versions, and submitted responses.

data.label: Customer
data.description: Data customer pemilik toko, tipe, group, channel, dan sub channel-nya.
data.descriptionEn: Customer records that own stores, with their type, group, channel, and sub channel.

data.label: Master Customer
data.description: Daftar pilihan tipe, group, channel, dan sub channel customer.
data.descriptionEn: Reference lists of customer types, groups, channels, and sub channels.

data.label: Produk
data.description: Master produk, satuan, barcode, dan custom field per company.
data.descriptionEn: Product master data, units of measure, barcodes, and per-company custom fields.

data.label: Master Produk
data.description: Kategori, sub kategori, brand, principal, satuan, dan pajak.
data.descriptionEn: Categories, sub categories, brands, principals, units, and taxes.

data.label: Daftar Harga
data.description: Daftar harga per periode dan penugasannya ke customer.
data.descriptionEn: Period-based price lists and their assignment to customers.

data.label: Data Master Order
data.description: Tipe order, alasan, termin bayar, dan metode bayar.
data.descriptionEn: Order types, reasons, payment terms, and payment methods.

data.label: Order
data.description: Order penjualan, sample, free goods, dan replacement, beserta custom field-nya.
data.descriptionEn: Sales, sample, free goods, and replacement orders, and their custom fields.

data.label: Persetujuan Order
data.description: Menyetujui atau menolak order yang menunggu persetujuan.
data.descriptionEn: Approve or reject orders awaiting approval.

data.label: Pengiriman Order
data.description: Mencatat jumlah yang diterima penerima dan mengoreksi catatan pengiriman.
data.descriptionEn: Record quantities received by the recipient and correct delivery records.

data.label: Laporan
data.description: Laporan waktu kerja, ekspor PDF/Excel, laporan terjadwal, dan ringkasan manajer.
data.descriptionEn: Work-hour reports, PDF/Excel exports, scheduled reports, and manager summaries.

data.label: Log Audit
data.description: Riwayat perubahan data perusahaan, recycle bin, dan pemulihan baris terhapus.
data.descriptionEn: History of company data changes, the recycle bin, and restoring deleted rows.

data.label: Langganan & Tagihan
data.description: Paket langganan perusahaan, tagihan, dan perubahan/pembatalan langganannya.
data.descriptionEn: The company's subscription plan, invoices, and plan changes/cancellation.

data.label: Invoice Timesheet
data.description: Invoice yang dibuat dari timesheet yang sudah disetujui.
data.descriptionEn: Invoices generated from approved timesheets.

data.label: Pengaturan Perusahaan
data.description: Profil perusahaan, tautan undangan, konfigurasi aplikasi, dan setelan sistem.
data.descriptionEn: Company profile, invite links, app configuration, and system settings.

data.label: Integrasi
data.description: Koneksi perusahaan ke ClickUp, Jira, Discord, dan Google Calendar bersama.
data.descriptionEn: Company connections to ClickUp, Jira, Discord, and shared Google Calendar.

data.label: Kalender Pribadi
data.description: Koneksi Google Calendar milik karyawan sendiri dan acara di dalamnya.
data.descriptionEn: An employee's own Google Calendar connection and its events.

data.label: Visibilitas Kolom Tabel
data.description: Matriks role × kolom yang menentukan kolom mana disensor di tabel data (docs/table_field_visibility.md).
data.descriptionEn: The role × column matrix that decides which columns are censored in data tables (docs/table_field_visibility.md).

data.label: Access Level (lama)
data.description: CRUD tabel `accessLevel` mentah — jalur backoffice lama, digantikan Peran & Hak Akses.
data.descriptionEn: Raw CRUD on the `accessLevel` table — the old backoffice path, superseded by Roles & Permissions.
